metadata.title: Email Threat Protection Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the architectural pattern for protecting institutional email services against malicious, abusive, or fraudulent activity. This pattern is vendor-agnostic and does not specify product implementations.

components.title: Email Threat Protection
components.description: Detects, prevents, and responds to malicious, abusive, or deceptive email content, including spam, phishing, malware, and impersonation attempts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Malicious code protection is required to detect and prevent malware delivered via email.
Email services must detect and mitigate system monitoring indicators of compromise and abuse.
Email services must be protected against spam, phishing, and spoofing attacks.
Supply chain and third-party service risks affecting email threat protection must be addressed.

components.remarks: This pattern defines the architectural requirement for email threat detection and prevention. Vendor-specific capabilities, baselines, and lifecycle considerations are defined in realization artifacts.
